title: transfer_moves_exact_amount
description: A successful transfer(to, v) decreases the caller's balance by v and increases to's balance by v (no change when caller == to), leaves every other balance and totalSupply unchanged, and returns true.

title: transfer_from_moves_exact_amount_and_spends_allowance
description: A successful transferFrom(from, to, v) moves exactly v from from to to, leaves other balances and totalSupply unchanged, decreases allowance[from][caller] by exactly v when caller != from and the allowance is finite, and leaves it unchanged when it is max uint256 or caller == from.

title: transfer_revert_conditions
description: transfer reverts if and only if msg.value != 0, to is the zero address or the sDAI contract, or the caller's balance is below the amount: a holder can always transfer up to their balance to a valid address.

title: transfer_from_revert_conditions
description: transferFrom reverts if and only if msg.value != 0, to is invalid (zero or sDAI), from's balance is insufficient, or the caller is not from and holds a finite allowance below the amount.

title: balance_decrease_requires_owner_or_allowance
description: For every sDAI method: if an account's share balance decreases, then the caller is that account, or the caller held an allowance from it at least as large as the decrease, which is reduced by exactly the decrease unless it is infinite.

title: allowance_increase_requires_owner_authorization
description: For every sDAI method: allowance[owner][spender] can only increase when the caller is the owner (approve, increaseAllowance) or through permit for that owner; no method changes an allowance for a pair other than (caller, spender) except permit for (owner, spender) and spending by the caller as spender.

title: allowance_management_functions_correct
description: approve sets allowance[caller][spender] to value; increaseAllowance adds exactly addedValue (reverting on overflow); decreaseAllowance subtracts exactly subtractedValue and reverts when it exceeds the current allowance; none changes balances or other allowances.

title: erc20_ops_preserve_vault_backing
description: transfer, transferFrom, approve, increaseAllowance and decreaseAllowance never change totalSupply, the Pot pie of sDAI, or any DAI or Vat dai balance.
